interestRatePct.quote: The interest rate of 5.0 percent is used to calculate capital recovery cost and is the effective long- term interest rate effective January 2018.

operatingInterestRatePct.quote: Interest on operating capital is based on cash operating costs and is calculated monthly until sale months at a nominal rate of 5.5 percent per year.

capitalRecoveryFormula.quote: The formula for the calculation of the annual capital recovery costs is: ((Purchase Price – Salvage Value) x (Capital Recovery Factor)) + (Salvage Value x Interest Rate).

salvageMethod.quote: Salvage value is an estimate of the remaining value of an investment at the end of its useful life.
